notes: Recorded from the HEC subject list read in full: bachelor 5 groups (the list names five BS groups with examples in brackets, not individual subjects); master 251 subjects in ten groups; doctorate 203 subjects in ten groups. The document states no totals. Subject names are kept as HEC writes them; a subject that appears in two groups is listed in each.
In the bachelor list HEC writes Phycology in the social sciences group; it is recorded as Psychology.
HEC does not tie subjects to universities in this list (a separate page names participating engineering and general universities without programmes), so no institution is given.
On the application form the applicant also enters an area of research or specialisation, which is not limited by this list as far as the pages say.
not_stated: Which participating university offers which subject.
